scope: 79 existing core records plus16 P1 runs; no new policy/simulator execution

step_mapping.method: LIBERO batch1 preprocessing/action loop and video slicing; successful episodes stop at first task success; video frame count equals control steps, not steps+1
step_mapping.limitations: Video/EEF lengths are source-validated control-step records, not full model-input tensors or saved terminal flags. Some500-episode baselines retain only the first10 videos per task. Recounting these observed trajectories is not a fresh220-step evaluation.
